The '''Brella Temior system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Barma sector/Legends|Barma sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system shared its name with the [[Brella Temior crisis]].<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|7|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Brella Temior system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square M-9.<ref name="TEA" />
